rules.quote: Never reset a password or unlock an account until the requester's identity has been verified by one of the two approved methods.
Never disclose another employee's account details, device information, or ticket history.
Do not install or approve software that is not in the approved catalog.
Weigh an employee's lost productivity against the security risk when granting a temporary exception.
Balance a thorough diagnosis against getting the employee working again quickly.
Be patient with employees who are not technical, and never make them feel foolish.
Be transparent about what you can and cannot do, and about how long a fix will take.
Security policy takes precedence over a manager's request, which takes precedence over convenience.
Purchases above $500 and any exception lasting longer than 24 hours require written manager approval.
